title: Diffuse Adiabatic Flows in Thermally Coupled Grounded Shallow Ice Sheets: Modelling and Analysis
summary: In this article we propose a novel thermodynamical model which couples the evolution of the thickness of a grounded shallow ice sheet with the evolution of its internal temperature. Both the grounded shallow ice sheet surface elevation and the ice internal temperature are subjected to physical constraints. The equations governing the evolution of the grounded shallow ice sheet thickness are degenerate, and the ice internal temperature evolves in a moving domain.
